comparison.objective: Orient a parcel with the designated side up, versus tune and lock an industrial shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Parcel grasping and reorientation differ from small-tool alignment, fine collar adjustment, bimanual stabilization, and torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Correct parcel orientation differs from two safe carriage stops and witness-tested setting retention. Specs and orientation tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: The record tests pose correction, not commissioning of a physically adjustable mechanism.
